description: Meet your nursery's storage powerhouse. The Addison 6 Drawer Dresser offers six spacious drawers with dovetail construction and full-extension glides, providing ample room for onesies, sleepers, blankets, and everything in between. Crafted from solid hardwood in a gorgeous Brown Maple finish, this dresser brings both function and beauty to your baby's room. The flat top is perfect for a changing pad, making diaper changes easy and comfortable. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout. Coordinates with the full Addison collection for a pulled-together nursery look you'll adore. From newborn layettes to big-kid clothes, this dresser grows with your child.
